findings.title: Authorability gate logic lives only in browser JS — no server-side equivalent for agents
findings.why_it_matters: isTemplateActionAuthorable and getEnabledActions are pure JS functions loaded only via a browser <script> tag. An agent using create_bundle + apply_action_grid can pass any action_key without knowing which actions are authorable for a given template set. The registry data returned by get_templates() contains all the fields needed to reproduce the gate (authorable, proof_only, skin_family_scope, prefix_catalog, template_actions), but the gate logic is not documented in the MCP tool description or system prompt, so agents lack the context to apply it correctly.
findings.suggested_fix: Either: (a) add a server-side /api/workbench/bundle/enabled-actions endpoint that accepts template_set_key and returns the filtered action list, then expose it as an MCP tool; or (b) document the gating algorithm in the get_templates and create_bundle tool docstrings so agents can apply the same logic from the registry payload they already receive.
evidence: web/workbench-template-gating.js:34 — isTemplateActionAuthorable is a browser-only export
scripts/workbench_mcp_server.py:287 — create_bundle accepts any template_set_key with no authorability check
scripts/workbench_mcp_server.py:303 — apply_action_grid accepts any action_key with no authorability check
scripts/workbench_mcp_server.py:276 — get_templates returns full registry including authorable/proof_only fields, but no filtering

findings.title: workbench.js delegation wrapper silently changes behavior for template_actions with empty templateSetKey
findings.why_it_matters: The old isTemplateActionAuthorable in workbench.js had: `if (templateActions.length && templateSetKey)` — meaning a non-empty template_actions list with an empty templateSetKey was treated as authorable (the condition was never entered). The new pure implementation in workbench-template-gating.js has: `if (templateActions.length) { if (!tsk) return false; }` — which returns false when templateSetKey is empty and template_actions is non-empty. This is a behavior change under the same UI surface, not a neutral refactor. It does not affect agents directly, but it confirms the extraction introduced a logic delta that may gate previously-visible UI actions.
findings.suggested_fix: Verify whether the old behavior (empty templateSetKey + non-empty template_actions = authorable) was intentional or a latent bug. If it was a bug fix, document it explicitly in the commit and test it. If it was unintentional, revert the pure function to match: `if (templateActions.length && tsk) { ... }`.
evidence: web/workbench.js diff line -7016: old guard was `if (templateActions.length && templateSetKey)` — short-circuits when templateSetKey is falsy
web/workbench-template-gating.js:54-61: new guard is `if (templateActions.length) { if (!tsk) return false; }` — explicitly returns false when templateSetKey is empty

tests/web/workbench-template-gating.test.js:307 — test covers the new behavior (returns false when templateSetKey empty + template_actions non-empty) but does not assert the old behavior was different

residual_risks: Agents calling apply_action_grid with a non-authorable action_key will receive a server error or silently store an invalid action result, since the API does not enforce the client-side gate.
If proof_only skin families are added to the registry in future, agents have no signal to avoid them without reading the full registry and re-implementing the gate logic.
The behavior delta in isTemplateActionAuthorable (template_actions + empty templateSetKey) is untested against a live registry snapshot; the test suite only covers the new behavior.
testing_gaps: No test covers the old behavior (template_actions non-empty, templateSetKey empty, old code returns true) alongside the new behavior to document the intentional delta.
No integration test verifies that apply_action_grid rejects or warns on a non-authorable action_key server-side.
No test for the getEnabledActions canonical ordering when template_actions linking is active (template_actions non-empty + valid templateSetKey).
